activationContract.binding: 本次 restore job、一次性 successor nonce、cold PID、canonical target 及 dev/ino、target authority、source result proof SHA256
activationContract.write: cold 仅 write/inspect；create-only，stage→fsync→flush→rename→flush→capture；target 身份在写前与 rename 前复核
activationContract.consume: successor 仅 inspect/remove；prepare/inspectBoot/complete 三次绑定，ready 后按 receipt sha/dev/ino CAS 删除
activationContract.ordinaryBoot: 普通 serve/CLI 没有 successor input，不读取、写入或删除 TEMP activation 收据；activation 分支不创建 target resultReader
activationContract.sourceResult: 持久 result 仍是固定九字段，restored 只有 target+activation；内存 restartRoot 仍为 source base，不写 restartRoot/publication/activationTarget 或根偏好
activationContract.failure: 写收据/spawn/ready 失败不重试、不回落 source；restore 缺 activationTarget 显式 activation_target_missing；删除失败不撤销已发布 ready
